Superteam Academy — Design System Reference

Every value on this page was extracted from the running implementation. Nothing here is aspirational: if a token is not in globals.css, it is not on this page.

Generated file — do not hand-edit.
  • Regenerate: pnpm docs:design-system (or node scripts/gen-design-system-doc.mjs)
  • Verify freshness in CI: node scripts/gen-design-system-doc.mjs --check
  • Generator: scripts/gen-design-system-doc.mjs
  • Sources of truth: apps/web/src/styles/globals.css, apps/web/tailwind.config.ts, apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx, apps/web/src/components/ui/button.tsx, apps/web/src/components/ui/card.tsx
  • Token counts: 105 light (:root) · 105 dark ([data-theme="dark"]) · 105 distinct names

1. The canonical layer stack

Values flow in exactly one direction. Reach for the highest layer that can express what you need.

  1. CSS custom properties — apps/web/src/styles/globals.css. Light values live on :root; dark values override on [data-theme="dark"]. This is the only place a raw hex/rgba belongs.
  2. Tailwind semantic mapping — apps/web/tailwind.config.ts maps those variables to named tokens (bg-primary, text-text-2, border-border-strong, shadow-card, rounded-lg, font-display…). Dark mode is darkMode: ["selector", "[data-theme='dark'], so dark: variants key off the same data attribute.
  3. cva primitives — apps/web/src/components/ui/*. button.tsx is the model: every visual decision is a named variant, and consumers pick a variant rather than restyling.
  4. Shared class constants — apps/web/src/lib/styles/styleClasses.ts for repeated multi-class recipes. Note that only CERTIFICATE_STYLES and TOAST_STYLES currently have importers — see “Shipped but unapplied”.
  5. Component-local classes — last resort, and only from tokens.

2. Usage rules

  • DO use the named tailwind token: bg-primary, text-text-3, border-border-strong, bg-sg-3, shadow-card.
  • DON'T write arbitrary-value escapes for tokens that already have a name — bg-[var(--primary)] is the same pixel as bg-primary but it hides the token from grep and from the config. Arbitrary values are legitimate only for variables the config does not map (see the “Tailwind token” column — rows marked — genuinely require var(), e.g. bg-[var(--card-glass)], border-[var(--border-default)]).
  • NEVER hardcode a hex or rgba in a component. If a colour does not exist as a token, add it to both theme blocks in globals.css first.
  • Theme selector: dark mode is [data-theme="dark"] on <html>, set by next-themes (attribute="data-theme"). There is no .dark class and no .light class — a selector like .light .pill never matches.
  • Fonts: font-display (Nunito) for headings, numerals, buttons and pills — anything with weight ≥ 700. font-sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) is the body default, already applied on <body>, so only re-declare it to undo a display context. font-mono (JetBrains Mono) for code, addresses, hashes and any tabular figure.
  • Solana gradient: --sol-grad / bg-cert-gradient is a brand accent used across certificates, mastery bars, deploy CTAs and marketing surfaces. It is not certificate-only — but it is never a background for body text.
  • New tokens must be added to both :root and [data-theme="dark"], then mapped in tailwind.config.ts, then regenerated here.

3. Colour & value tokens

Swatches are live: each cell renders var(--token) inside a context carrying that theme's real declarations, copied verbatim from globals.css. The “Tailwind token” column lists the class stem — combine with bg-, text-, border-, from-… as appropriate.

4. Typography

Fonts are self-hosted through next/font/google in apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx — no runtime Google Fonts request, which is why the CSP does not allow fonts.googleapis.com. This page deliberately loads no webfonts either; if a family is not installed locally you will see the fallback, but the stack and weights below are exact.

RoleFamilyCSS variableTailwindWeights loadeddisplay
fontSansPlus Jakarta Sans--font-sansfont-sans font-body400, 500, 600, 700swap
fontDisplayNunito--font-displayfont-display600, 700, 800, 900swap
fontMonoJetBrains Mono--font-monofont-monodefault—

The <body> element carries ${fontSans.variable} ${fontDisplay.variable} ${fontMono.variable} overflow-x-clip font-sans antialiased. Base type is set in globals.css: font-size: 14px, line-height: 1.6, -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased. There is no global heading scale — headings size themselves with tailwind utilities per surface (e.g. CardTitle = font-display text-2xl font-extrabold leading-none tracking-tight).

shadow-push / shadow-push-sm / shadow-push-active compose --shadow-push-color into the 3D press effect used by the button primitive; the pressed state is active:translate-y-[2px] plus the shorter shadow.

6. Component gallery

Every family below is rendered twice — once in each theme context — from the components' own class strings. Both panels share identical markup: the only difference is which token block the surrounding context carries, which is the whole point of the pipeline. Tailwind utilities on this page are compiled by the app's own Tailwind build; bespoke classes are lifted verbatim out of apps/web/src/styles/globals.css with their source line.

Caveats that apply throughout: Phosphor icon components render as text glyphs, next/image thumbnails as token-coloured boxes, and entry animations / position: fixed are neutralised so the page stays legible. Everything else is the real thing.

Buttons

Source: apps/web/src/components/ui/button.tsx

The only cva primitive in the codebase. Three core variants, four utility variants, six backward-compat aliases, four sizes. Aliases render identically to the variant they point at, so only the distinct visuals are shown.

Toasts

Source: apps/web/src/components/ui/toast-container.tsx · apps/web/src/lib/styles/styleClasses.ts:366-380

The toast system supports exactly four variants — success, error, warning, info (ToastVariant, toast-container.tsx:14; default info). There is no XP toast: XP awards render as a .popup-xp pill, shown under “Celebration popups”. Dispatched with dispatchToast(message, variant); auto-dismiss 5000 ms; entry animation is inline pop-spring 0.4s. Phosphor icons are replaced with text glyphs here.

Pills &amp; badges

Source: apps/web/src/styles/globals.css (.pill family) · apps/web/src/components/course/difficulty-badge.tsx · apps/web/src/components/admin/admin-badge.tsx · apps/web/src/components/admin/status-badge.tsx · apps/web/src/components/community/thread-status-badge.tsx · bespoke CSS inlined from apps/web/src/styles/globals.css: .pill .pill-primary .pill-beg .pill-int .pill-adv .pill-xp .pill-streak .pill-level .pill-sol .pill-done

Four parallel badge systems exist. The .pill-* family shown first is defined in globals.css but applied by no component — every reference to it in TypeScript is a comment (its Tailwind mirror, PILL_STYLES in styleClasses.ts, has no importers either). It is drawn here because it is still ~80 lines of shipped CSS, not because anything renders it. The live systems are DifficultyBadge (course pages), AdminBadge/StatusBadge (admin), ThreadStatusBadge (forum) — and the course card carries its own .course-card-diff chip instead of DifficultyBadge.

Cards

Source: apps/web/src/components/ui/card.tsx · apps/web/src/styles/globals.css (.card-chunky) · apps/web/src/components/course/course-card.tsx · apps/web/src/components/dashboard/continue-card.tsx · bespoke CSS inlined from apps/web/src/styles/globals.css: .card-chunky .course-card .course-card-thumb .course-num .course-card-body .course-card-top .course-card-title .course-card-desc .course-card-foot .course-card-stat .course-card-xp .course-card-path .course-card-diff .course-card-status

Four card idioms coexist: the shadcn Card primitive (static, 1px --border-default), the chunky 2.5px .card-chunky, the fully bespoke .course-card, and the gradient-bordered continue card (a Tailwind-only composition with the Solana gradient as a 2.5px padding layer). The course-card thumbnail is a placeholder box here.

Navigation

Source: apps/web/src/components/layout/header.tsx · apps/web/src/components/layout/mobile-bottom-nav.tsx · apps/web/src/components/layout/theme-toggle.tsx · apps/web/src/components/ui/tabs.tsx · apps/web/src/app/[locale]/(platform)/courses/courses-client.tsx:187 · bespoke CSS inlined from apps/web/src/styles/globals.css: .nav-bar .nav-link .mobile-bottom-nav .mobile-bottom-nav-item .catalog-tabs .catalog-tab

The desktop nav is a floating pill bar (.nav-bar, absolutely centred in the header); the active link gets .active. The mobile bar is a separate bespoke component shown below lg. Three unrelated tab idioms exist: the Radix Tabs primitive, the bespoke .catalog-tab strip, and the leaderboard's .lb-*-tabs. The mobile nav is rendered here in flow rather than fixed.

7. Class strings that do nothing

Found while building this page and verified on every regeneration: these strings are written in components but compile to no CSS under apps/web/tailwind.config.ts, or name a bespoke class that apps/web/src/styles/globals.css never defines. They are listed here as documentation of the current state — fixing them is a code change, not a docs change.

ClassUsed atWhy it produces nothing
bg-primary-dimapps/web/src/components/dashboard/cohort-strip.tsx:59the primary palette has no dim key — only --primary-dim the CSS variable. Other files write [background:var(--primary-dim)].
bg-surface-3apps/web/src/components/dashboard/mastery-panel.tsx:52there is no surface colour in the Tailwind config at all, so the mastery bar has no track background.
bg-success/10apps/web/src/components/review/review-session.tsx:81opacity modifiers need an <alpha-value> placeholder; every colour here is a bare var(--x), so /10, /40, /5 and /60 all drop out.
border-success/40apps/web/src/components/review/review-session.tsx:96same alpha-modifier limitation.
hover:bg-subtle/60apps/web/src/components/landing/paths-explorer.tsx:112same alpha-modifier limitation — the idle path tab has no hover background.
.lb-headerapps/web/src/app/[locale]/(platform)/leaderboard/leaderboard-client.tsx:386bespoke class with no rule in apps/web/src/styles/globals.css.
.sidebar-progapps/web/src/components/layout/sidebar.tsx:248bespoke class with no rule in apps/web/src/styles/globals.css.

Shipped but unapplied

WhatWhereEvidence

The eight .light .pill-* overrides below them are doubly dead — .light is never a class either.

The @/lib/styles barrel has none at all, despite the file header saying "All components MUST import styles from this file".

8. Retheming checklist

  1. Edit the hex/rgba in :root and [data-theme="dark"] in apps/web/src/styles/globals.css. Both blocks must stay name-for-name identical.
  2. Only add to apps/web/tailwind.config.ts if you introduced a new variable that deserves a semantic class.
  3. Four surfaces sit outside the CSS-variable pipeline and must be updated by hand: the Monaco editor themes (apps/web/src/components/editor/themes.ts), the transactional email templates (apps/web/src/lib/email/templates.ts — mail clients do not support custom properties), third-party brand marks (apps/web/src/components/icons/*), and canvas/SVG literals in a handful of landing and dashboard components.
  4. Regenerate this page and diff it: the diff is the change log for the design system.
